Subject: Request: pilot onboarding + invoice-only billing (no PO)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited by the potential fit for CloudFlux at Redwood Inference. We can get a small technical pilot up and running next week. One ask on our side: because our finance team is still configuring purchase orders for external vendors, we generally onboard new partners on an invoice-only basis (net 30) for pilots under $10k. Can Redwood accommodate a temporary invoice-only onboarding path (no PO) for this pilot?

Attached is our vendor intake form and the quote. If helpful, I can route a signed proposal via DocuSign.

Attachments: vendor-intake-form.pdf

Would appreciate a quick flag on whether procurement requires strict PO from day one or if a short exception is possible.

Best,

Marissa / Rachel,

Forwarding a request from CloudFlux — small pilot, asking for invoice-only onboarding while they finish their PO setup. Quote in the intake form shows initial spend under $5k.

My read: low risk, strategic partner trial, but we should set guardrails so this doesn't become a precedent. Options: a short temporary exception with capped spend + evidence requirements, or require payment by card/prepay.

Can procurement advise what minimum evidence we need and a recommended timebox (30 vs 60 days)? If procurement is OK, I can give them a conditional sign-off so engineering can schedule kickoff.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot onboarding + invoice-only billing (no PO)

Jonas — thanks for the ping.

Short answer: we can allow a temporary invoice-only path for low-dollar pilots but need a checklist completed and a time-limited approval from Finance. For this to be acceptable we need the following before kickoff:

- Completed vendor intake form (they attached it; confirm all fields).
- W-9 or equivalent tax form on file.
- Basic security posture: either SOC 2 Type II report or self-attestation + remediation plan.
- Point of contact for billing and a formal quote (DocuSign preferred).

If those are provided, Procurement recommends a 30-day exception window with a hard spend cap of $5,000. We will log this as an exception (procurement-exception-2027-458) so we can track precedent. Please note we require a single invoice per month and net-30 terms.

I attached our procurement-checklist for the vendor team to complete. If the vendor can't supply SOC2, we can still proceed but need security approval and a reduced cap.

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf

-Marissa
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | x4723
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot onboarding + invoice-only billing (no PO)

Adding a quick risk note from CS/Finance perspective.

Two operational concerns if we allow invoice-only for pilots:

1) Precedent creep — other small vendors will ask for the same and it becomes admin overhead. Logging as an exception helps, but we should attach a strict expiration and a single-use flag on the vendor account.

2) Reconciliation friction — if the vendor invoices and we need to dispute, it delays payment. For pilots I prefer an advance hold (company card on file or prepay) OR require a purchase order after the first invoice.

Proposal: If Marissa's checklist is satisfied but they lack SOC2, approve a 60-day exception (instead of 30) with a $5k cap AND require a company card on file for auto-collection OR a prepayment for the first month. That reduces collections risk and gives them runway to get PO'd.

Happy to sync on a 15-min call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Rachel
Director, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@cloudflux.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudFlux pilot - invoice-only onboarding exception request

Alex —

Thanks for the patience. After conversations with Procurement and CS, Redwood can proceed with a conditional invoice-only onboarding for the CloudFlux technical pilot. Summary of the decision and next steps:

1) Approval window: 60 days from the pilot start date.
2) Spend cap: $5,000 total for the pilot period.
3) Required paperwork before kickoff: completed vendor intake form (you already attached it), W-9, and either SOC 2 Type II or a written security self-attestation + remediation timeline.
4) Billing guardrail: provide a company card on file for auto-collection or prepay the first invoice. If neither is possible, Redwood will limit the service until a PO is in place.
5) We'll record this as Procurement Exception CFX-EX-2027-09 and track in the vendor ledger to avoid precedent creep.

Please upload the W-9 and any security docs to the DocuSign packet I just sent: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC123-cloudflux-proposal. Once procurement confirms receipt, Marissa will issue the exception and Rachel will coordinate billing. Engineering can schedule kickoff the following week.

If this works, Alex please reply-all with estimated pilot start date and confirm whether you can provide card-on-file or prepay.

Jonas
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
